shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示整件版型
一秒传达贴身舒适好睡眠的核心利益
对比粗糙凸缝与平整缝接，放大摩擦皮肤的风险
代入真实夜间育儿场景，营造温暖安心的睡眠氛围
微距展示按扣做工与面料织纹，证明贴身品质
逐点讲清领口、缝接、开档、面料四项结构细节
并列展示多色可选，方便家长快速选色
用洗涤图标与空白规格表降低尺码与打理疑虑
收口促单，暗示多件组合更划算

style.backgroundSystem: creamy off-white #FFF9F5 for packshots, soft sakura pink #F5D4DE and pale sky blue #BFE0F0 panels for info and scene shots
style.iconSystem: thin rounded-line icons in one accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio lighting, front-left key with wide fill, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft warm baby sleepwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of creamy off-white #FFF9F5, sakura pink #F5D4DE, pale sky blue #BFE0F0, warm brown text #6B5B4E and one soft accent; bright soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif; consistent thin rounded-line icon style; clean cozy baby-garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment across the set, garments laid flat or gently folded, never floating
style.surfaceSystem: matte cream board #F2EAE2 and soft folded cotton surface
